note: The United Arab Emirates: the other Gulf Cooperation Council states' citizens move freely; nationals of the countries listed get a visit visa on arrival at no charge (180 days for Albania and Mexico, 90 in any 180 for the EU but Ireland and most of the Americas, Europe and the Pacific listed, 30 for the rest listed). Everyone else needs a visit visa arranged beforehand through a sponsor, airline or hotel (Indians and some others holding a US visa or an EU or UK residence may get one on arrival: not modelled). ICP's and the UAE portal's pages refuse this client, so the list is read from Wikipedia's copy.
